title: Five regional readings complete current-account coverage on the original Place Atlas routes
summary: Nevada lithium, California autonomous mobility, Victoria grid storage, Florida utility storage and California battery safety gain separately scoped readings from retained sources. All fifteen original Atlas place routes now have dedicated current accounts; two excluded parents remain Context, not eligible places.
evidence_note: Thirty sections reuse forty-two exact source records and ten retained narrative/review inputs. November 22 is authorship and AI self-review, not new inspection. Nevada retains November 21 checks, the three other November accounts retain November 22 checks, and Victoria retains September 22–23. These five places have no assigned Phase 60 gate; no receipts or appointments were invented.
publication_effect: No new eligible identities, stages, safety classifications or operating outcomes. The catalog contains 334 readings and eligibility remains 100 projects and 70 places. Source integration is not production acceptance, publication, launch or completed stewardship.
